Results.ReviewText:
I am a pitmaster, always relied upon wood smokers and charcoal grills.  I never found a gas grill worth foolin' with.  And then I purchased my Weber.  Great grill.  consistent heat throughout the grilling surface.  I was drawn to the 10 year Warranty.  Previous experiences with propane grills left me replacing burners, flame tamers, and eventually tossing the whole thing after about a years use.  Due to rust and component failures.

The Weber holds up well, is easy to clean.  I like the aluminum pan inserts for the grease tray drain.  I also like the removable basin below the burners for easy clean up.  Being able to get your drippings, cooked sauces residue, and all the food particles and seasonings that fall from the food during the cooking process, out of the base of the grill regularly helps you keep your grill clean and makes it last longer.  The more you leave that stuff in there, the more moisture builds up to rust and rot components .   So I do like the easy clean. 
Another feature that is a good reference is the propane tank hanger with the "scale" that indicates approx amount of gas in the tank.  It gives you a really good idea of how much cook time you have on that tank.  I like the cabinet door that allows you to store my optional smoker box, for wood chips.  And the way the cabinet holds all the utensils I want to store.  On the sides are several clips to hand your tools for cooking and I use them all.

It's a great package... the 10 year warranty was the clincher for me.  We'll see if this is the brand I stick with from now on.  I already had the Weber Kettle grill for charcoal....and if I'm in the mood to fuss with ashes, and coals, etc.  I will roll that out.  I've had it for years and it still cooks good as new too.

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it.
